cache.clear.confirm.en: Clear this layer's cached data or learned records? User changes are preserved.
cache.clear.confirm.zh-CN: 清空此层缓存数据或学习记录？用户修改保留。

cache.description.en: Keeps what has already been read — folders and file contents — so going back to a place you have seen does not fetch it again. The least recently used content is dropped when the limit is reached.
cache.description.zh-CN: 保存已经读过的目录与文件内容，再次访问不必重新下载；达到容量上限时丢弃最久未用的内容。

cache.writable.description.en: When on, writes stop here instead of reaching the layer below. A read cache placed above the local-changes layer normally leaves this off.
cache.writable.description.zh-CN: 打开后，写入会留在这个缓存层，不会落到下面的层。放在本地修改层上方的读取缓存通常保持关闭。

overlay.description.en: Keeps your changes — new files, edits and deletions — on this machine. The source is not touched.
overlay.description.zh-CN: 把你的新建、修改与删除保存在本机，源保持不变。

storage.path.description.en: Leave empty to use the instance's default storage directory.
storage.path.description.zh-CN: 留空使用实例默认存储目录。

overlay.discard.confirm.en: Discard all local changes in this layer?
overlay.discard.confirm.zh-CN: 丢弃此层的全部本地修改？

memory.description.en: Keeps recently read and written data in memory. It is emptied when the instance restarts.
memory.description.zh-CN: 在内存中保存最近读写的数据，实例重启后清空。

directory.description.en: Uses a folder on this machine as the source.
directory.description.zh-CN: 把本机上的一个文件夹作为数据源。

prediction.description.en: Learns the order you open files in and fetches the likely next ones into the cache below before you ask for them.
prediction.description.zh-CN: 记住你打开文件的顺序，在你读取之前把接下来可能用到的文件装入下方的缓存。

prediction.profile.description.en: How hard preloading tries to keep ahead of the reader. It cannot reduce the number of source reads, only start them earlier so they overlap; higher tiers compete with the foreground load for the source. The fields below apply only to Custom.
prediction.profile.description.zh-CN: 预载追赶读取方的积极程度。它不能减少回源次数，只能把回源提前以形成重叠；档位越高越会与前台加载争抢源。下面各字段仅在「自定义」下生效。

prediction.demand.zh-CN: 预载时允许的同时读取数

prediction.demand.description.en: The reader spends most of its time waiting for a read to finish, so too small a value leaves preloading almost no window.
prediction.demand.description.zh-CN: 读取请求大部分时间都还没结束，这个数太小，预载就几乎没有空隙。

prediction.idle.description.en: Quiet period required before preloading starts when nothing is being read.
prediction.idle.description.zh-CN: 没有正在进行的读取时，需要安静多久才开始预载。

prediction.tick.description.en: How often preloading is reconsidered. An interval longer than one read and it never catches the gap.
prediction.tick.description.zh-CN: 多久判断一次是否可以预载。间隔比一次读取还长，就总也赶不上。

prediction.inflight.description.en: One preload in flight stalls preloading completely.
prediction.inflight.description.zh-CN: 只要有一个预载在飞，预载就完全停手。

prediction.transitions.description.en: At capacity, new transitions evict the least used ones.
prediction.transitions.description.zh-CN: 满员后新顺序会淘汰使用最少的旧顺序。

prediction.filebytes.description.en: Files larger than this are never preloaded.
prediction.filebytes.description.zh-CN: 超过该大小的文件不做预载。

provider.prediction.zh-CN:
已预载 {0:N0} 次 · 用到 {1:N0} 次 · 未用到 {2:N0} 次
内存 {3} / {4}

prediction.retention.description.en: A transition not seen for this long is dropped, so a sequence the loader has moved on from stops being predicted. 0 keeps transitions until the capacity bound recycles them.
prediction.retention.description.zh-CN: 超过该时间未被观察到的转移会被丢弃，避免加载器已经不再使用的旧顺序一直被预测并向后传递。0 表示只按容量上限回收。

prediction.successors.description.en: How many distinct successors one path may accumulate, ranked by how often each was seen. A single slot would let one divergence replace the evidence for everything before it.
prediction.successors.description.zh-CN: 一个路径最多记多少个不同后继，按各自被观察到的次数排序。只留一个槽位的话，一次分歧就会把它之前积累的证据全部覆盖掉。

prediction.confidence.description.en: Share of a path's observations its leading successor must hold before it is read ahead. Reading ahead spends real source bandwidth, so a coin flip is not worth it.
prediction.confidence.description.zh-CN: 领头后继需要占该路径全部观察的多少比例才会被预载。预载要花真实的源带宽，抛硬币级别的把握不值得。

prediction.context.description.en: How many recent paths form the key. One is the last-address key; a longer window can tell apart successors that a single preceding path conflates.
prediction.context.description.zh-CN: 用最近多少个路径作为键。1 就是「上一个路径」；更长的窗口能区分被单个前驱混淆掉的不同后继。

prediction.depth.description.en: How many confident steps to follow. Read-ahead issues the same reads either way; depth decides how far ahead of the reader they land.
prediction.depth.description.zh-CN: 沿预测路径连续走几步。两种情况下回源次数相同，深度只决定它们落在读者前面多远。

provider.memory.zh-CN: 内存 · 命中 {0:N0} 次 · 未命中 {1:N0} 次 · 写回 {2:N0} 次

warmup.description.en: Keeps this instance's directory listings in a store of its own and never evicts one, because a lost ancestor hides everything beneath it. After mounting it walks the folder tree in the background to fill that store, pausing whenever the instance is being read. It holds no file content.
warmup.description.zh-CN: 用自己的存储保存本实例的目录清单，且从不淘汰——丢掉一个祖先会让它下面的一切都不可达。挂载后在后台遍历目录把存储填满，有读取时自动让路。它不保存任何文件内容。

warmup.seconds.description.en: Bounds a pass when the source is slow; whichever budget runs out first stops it.
warmup.seconds.description.zh-CN: 源较慢时限制一趟的时长；两个上限谁先到就以谁为准。

warmup.quiet.description.en: How long the instance must go without a read before the walk takes another directory.
warmup.quiet.description.zh-CN: 实例多久没有读取之后，遍历才取下一个目录。
